Recommended Gems

Make sure you have one Indecipherable Eversong Diamond somewhere in your gear. This is the most valued gem out of all of them. Beyond that, fill any other sockets with Flawless Masterful Garnet.

2.

Best Enchants and Weapon Augments

Make sure to apply Thalassian Phoenix Oil to your weapon for all content.

Slot Enchantment
Rings Eyes of the Eagle or whatever your sim tells you to run. The practical difference is tiny.
Weapon Jan'alai's Precision
Chest Mark of the Worldsoul
Head Empowered Rune of Avoidance as a default, but tertiary stat enchants tend to be personal choice. Use whichever calls to you.
Shoulders Amirdrassil's Grace as a default, but tertiary stat enchants tend to be personal choice. Use whichever calls to you.
Boots Lynx's Dexterity as a default, but tertiary stat enchants tend to be personal choice. Use whichever calls to you.
Legs Sunfire Silk Spellthread

The deciding factor between Avoidance and Speed is simply if you feel like taking a minor amount less damage compared to moving faster at all times. You can make the argument for each in every scenario, even in extremely high-end content. Avoidance lets you survive larger hits; Speed gives you more leeway to run out of an AoE effect. You can pick whichever effect you prefer here.

For comparisons, full Avoidance enchants grant 4.54% of the stat, full Leech provides 3.52% of your damage as healing, and full Speed is 11.4% more movement speed.

TCWhy Do We Use Crit Enhancements Instead of Mastery?

While Mastery is our best stat in a vacuum, Potion of Recklessness really wants us to lean just marginally towards Crit when it is used. The reason for this is that Deep Shatter and Improved Shatter really enjoy the massive Crit boost from the potion during our opener.

3.

Optimal Consumables

In addition to enchants and improvements to your gear, making sure you come prepared with the right consumables to endgame content has a big impact on your performance.

3.1.

Flask

You should be drinking the Flask of the Shattered Sun at all times.

3.2.

Potions

Potion of Recklessness is the best DPS potion to use.

You should also keep a stock of Concentrated Silvermoon Health Potions to use when at low health, and if you have a Warlock in the group, grab their Healthstones and use them as well. Do not macro these together, they are best used separately!

3.3.

Food Buff

We recommend eating from the Harandar Celebration or Silvermoon Parade when possible, and if no feast is provided for your group, use personal food ( Royal Roast or Impossibly Royal Roast).

3.4.

Augment Rune

In addition, if you can afford it, you should use Void-Touched Augment Runes to increase your primary stat. Augment Runes are expensive, and disappear on death, so use them wisely!
